style: soft watercolor and colored pencil children's picture-book illustration, warm cozy palette of cream, honey yellow and warm orange with soft teal accents, gentle winter afternoon light, Korean neighborhood, absolutely no text, no letters, no writing, no signs with words

cards.p: a tiny cozy neighborhood library glowing warmly at the ground floor of a Korean apartment building on a snowy winter evening, warm window light, a child in a puffy coat and a parent walking toward the door holding hands, wide view with sky space at the top
inside a small cozy community library room, low wooden bookshelves, floor cushions, children reading picture books on the floor, a grandmother reading next to them, warm lamp light, steam from a mug
